I've finished round 135 (V-0.3b). The transport bar, tempo row, ruler, overview, loop brace and the navigation statuses in StudioWorkspace now show the English text from the task's map, word for word. All the checks I'm allowed to run pass. The browser checks haven't run yet; they are C's job in round 135.

**One mistake to know about:** I once wrote the word "PLACEHOLDER" over `ArrangementTransport.tsx` by accident. I restored it a few seconds later from a full copy I had prepared, and its sha256 matches that copy (`6fdc7aef…`). The diff against the start copy shows only the lines the task allowed. The running dev server may have tried to reload the broken file during those seconds; `/studio-lab` still returns 200. C should look at this file closely when checking the diff.

**What changed**
- **Strings:** the new texts were added to the six existing objects in `strings.ts`. There is no new object and the file still imports nothing.
- **Behaviour:** the five components and the 10 StudioWorkspace lines changed text only. Every condition and the order it picks in are unchanged, and the other 23 Georgian lines in StudioWorkspace are byte-for-byte the same.
- **Tests:**
  - The 9 Georgian checks in the four UI test files are now hand-written English.
  - `strings.test` adds to its expected lists, shrinks the list of Georgian lines still allowed in StudioWorkspace from 33 to 23, and gains 2 new tests (25 → 27).
  - New file `navigation-strings-ui.test.tsx` with 5 tests. It also covers the "Follow paused" state, which turned out to be reachable in the test environment by playing and then scrolling by hand.
- **Docs:** doc 110 gets its status fix, and the new doc 111 is in Georgian.
- **End state:** 13 modified files plus 2 new ones and nothing else. The frozen list checks OK, the protected files are unchanged, and HEAD is still `16533c1`.

**Checks run**
- The full 21-file test list from the task: 386 of 386 tests pass.
- Typecheck and lint pass. Lint prints 218 warnings that already existed elsewhere; none are in the changed files. Biome on the 13 changed or new code and test files is clean.
- I made each of the 7 deliberate breaks the task lists (m30–m36), plus one extra (m37). Each one made the named tests fail, and each file was then restored and confirmed by sha256.
- The code-reviewer subagent scored it 9/10 with no Critical, High or Medium findings. Its one Low was that the overview's scroll-position text was only checked at the start position. I fixed that in the new test, and the extra break m37 shows the check now works. The review ran just before that test-only fix.

**Notes for B**
- The loop hint says `(Ctrl+L)` while the Loop button titles say `(Ctrl/Cmd+L)`. This came from the Georgian originals and the spec kept it, so B can decide later whether to make them match.
- The reviewer's architecture note: keep `strings.ts` as one file for now. After V-0.3d, consider splitting it into one file per area, keeping the same import path. I didn't act on this.
- As planned, the range readout under the lanes stays Georgian next to the now-English Delete button until V-0.3d, and the marker texts until V-0.3c.

I have not marked the backlog complete. The report has the start and end hashes, every shell write, the incident, and the exact checks C should run next.
